APPELLANT: Robert Cadez
REGISTERED OWNER OF PROPERTY: Sean Nugent
CIVIC ADDRESS OF PROPERTY: 121 Warwick Avenue N.
LEGAL DESCRIPTION OF PROPERTY:
Lot: 33 Block: 47 District Lot: 218 Plan: NWP4953
APPEAL: An appeal for the relaxation of Part 3 Section 1.1.5 (Maximum Lot Coverage), (Minimum Lot Line Setbacks for All Buildings), and (Minimum Permeable Surfaces 40%), of the Burnaby Zoning Bylaw which if permitted would allow for the removal and replacement of failing retaining walls that support the elevated rear parking area and for construction of a new accessory building (garage).
The following variances are requested:
a) maximum lot coverage of 46% where a maximum lot coverage of 40% is allowed;
b) minimum permeable surface coverage of 34% where the requirement for minimum permeable surfacing is 40%;
c) lane yard set back of 1.2 m  where the requirement for a minimum lot line setback for accessory buildings from the rear (west) Lane Yard is 1.5m; and
d) interior side yard set back of 0.6 m where the requirement for a minimum lot line setback for all buildings from the northern interior side yard is 1.2 m.
5.

agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider Burnaby zoning variances for garage at 121 Warwick Ave N
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby's Board of Variance will hold a hearing on October 5, 2026 for BOV #6535 at 121 Warwick Avenue N, where the owner seeks four variances to build a 452 sq ft two-car garage replacing failing retaining walls and a rear parking pad. Requests include lot coverage of 46% instead of 40%, permeable surface of 34% instead of 40%, a lane setback of 1.2 m instead of 1.5 m, and a side yard setback of 0.6 m instead of 1.2 m. Approval does not guarantee a building permit.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Attend the Board of Variance hearing on October 5, 2026 if you want to speak for or against this variance application.
